title: Vitenzi (Theme 6: Usalama shuleni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the verb that carries the action (kikuu) and the one that only carries time or mood before it (kisaidizi).

floor.prerequisite: Finds the verb in a sentence.
floor.question: Kitenzi ni kipi: "Tulicheza."

representations: a list of helping verbs (kuwa, kwisha, kuweza)

board.say: Kitenzi hiki kinabeba tendo au kinasaidia?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels both verbs and writes one sentence with "anaweza".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Katika "Alikuwa akisoma", kitenzi kikuu ni kipi?" Kwa nini "alikuwa" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Atakuwa akifanya kazi", kitenzi kisaidizi ni kipi?" Kwa nini "akifanya" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Katika "Walikuwa wakicheza", kuna vitenzi vingapi?" Kwa nini "kimoja" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi hii ina kisaidizi na kikuu.

misconceptions.ask: Kuna kitenzi kingine katika sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Kuwa ni kisaidizi tu kinapotangulia kitenzi kingine.
